description: This file implements a service class for interacting with Grok's API using an OpenAI-compatible interface. It includes a context aggregator pair class, token usage tracking and accumulation, client creation, and context aggregator factory methods. The code extends existing OpenAI LLM service classes to integrate with Grok's specific API endpoint and features.

classes.name: GrokContextAggregatorPair
classes.description: A deprecated container class pairing user and assistant context aggregators for Grok LLM interactions.

classes.description: A specialized LLM service class for interacting with Grok's API, extending OpenAILLMService with token usage tracking and context aggregation tailored for Grok.
